checkpoint_types.CP1: Baseline — last verified remote-aligned state before a large change
checkpoint_types.CP2: Verified Implementation — implementation plus required Validation PASS
checkpoint_types.CP3: Evidence Snapshot — preserve original Runtime or important side-effect Evidence before Independent Review
checkpoint_types.CP4: Closure — Independent Review plus State Sync PASS

automatic_checkpoint_eligibility: no Architecture change unless separately approved
Evidence can link checkpoint and commit
automatic_rollback_prohibited_when: SSOT conflict or meaning ambiguity exists
automatic_recovery_candidate_scope: Only temporary artifact or cache recovery whose cause and successful recovery method are already verified.
no_change: If CP2, CP3, or CP4 has materially identical content, state, Evidence, and checkpoint meaning already on the remote, do not create a duplicate commit or push.
promotion: Requires separate Review and Promotion; this record does not activate the policy.
